title: Fly your first Kai Tak approach with the Landing lesson
dek: Nine coached steps from gear down to a full stop, with guide hoops and live meters.
description: Land at Kai Tak for the first time with the Landing lesson: nine coached steps on the IGS 13 approach, from gear down to braking to a stop.
hero_alt: The lesson panel at step 6, Turn right over the checkerboard, with a meter counting down the turn still to go, and the checkerboard on the hill beside the jet.
hero_caption: Step 6: the turn meter counts down to a runway-aligned heading.

zh.title: 用降落課程飛你第一次啟德進場
zh.dek: 九個教練步驟，由放起落架到完全停定，有導引圈同即時儀表。
zh.description: 用降落課程第一次喺啟德降落：IGS 13 進場嘅九個教練步驟，由放起落架到剎車停定。
zh.hero_alt: 課程面板第 6 步「喺棋盤右轉」，有倒數餘下轉彎角度嘅儀表，棋盤喺飛機旁邊嘅山上。
zh.hero_caption: 第 6 步：轉彎儀表倒數到同跑道對正嘅航向。
